description:
We’re a team of two who share an interest in space exploration and game development. We’re creating Beyond the Universe, an educational 3D game inspired by real space missions.

We want players to learn how rockets reach orbit, why fuel matters at every stage of a flight, and what makes a landing site safe. By planning a launch, choosing where to land, and collecting samples, players will see how decisions made before liftoff shape what a crew can do on the surface.
